set.body:
Bounded first slice: select the licensed/pinned inputs and generate or specify reproducible reference specimens for scanpaths, traces/events, heatmaps, AOI/reading, main sequence, QC and study comparisons. Map each family to current library/Studio rendering and export ownership; create narrow missing-family slices.

Freeze scientific/display conventions, physical output sizes, light/dark/HiDPI requirements and independent review rubric/thresholds before tuning appearance. Separate static publication output from interactive task success. Include noisy/overplotted, missing/off-screen and mismatched-scale cases that can expose misleading graphics. Record primary tasks, scientific rejection criteria and how ties/disagreements are retained.

Acceptance: versioned specimen manifest, pinned data/result hashes, reproducible reference generation and an explicit actual-render vs design-only coverage table. Rendering should consume verified results rather than recompute science. No claim of visual superiority until independent scored review and required export/interaction checks pass.
set.title: PM4.1 Freeze same-data visualization specimens and the review rubric
